items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Tom played nice trombone with them, too.

ctx.x: Oh, well, the records by the Owls, I loved it. Yeah.

They left nothing to be hoped for, I'll tell you. They had plenty of rhythm, tight combo. But I'll tell you, another band had a wonderful combo. I can't understand how he felt like he did, Johnny Posdorff. Mm-hmm. Oh, when Johnny was at the Tokyo Garden with Pete Skaglione and them guys, they had a group out of this world. They already played with him out there. Mm-hmm. They had a group out of this world, eh, for dance music. They really played some nice stuff. And then... Tom played nice trombone with them, too.
Who? Tom Brown. Yeah, Tom was with him.
